prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi-statue demi statue portrait, 9-band horizontal multi-material body, no bare skin below the collarbones. ONE woman, angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so her whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually finished thigh tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be, her face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop of just the face. Where her form comes to an end, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Latina woman in telenovela glam makeup — warm golden-bronze skin, a sharp black winged liner, warm terracotta eyeshadow, heavy lashes, strong sculpted contour, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep berry lip, long voluminous dark-brown waves swept over one shoulder, a fiery, passionate expression. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real face, not an illustration, not a render, not cel-shaded. On each ear a large gold hoop hangs clear of the neck down to the shoulder.

Physique: A colossal rounded chest, an enormous belly of massive rounded folds hanging low and heavy, no waist at all, left arm crystal, right arm stone, torso/hip/thigh-stubs in 9 stepped horizontal bands.

Boundary: a single straight, flat line runs around the base of the neck and across both collarbones, never jagged, never zigzag — real skin above, material immediately below, no skin anywhere lower. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step, casting a crisp shadow.

Left arm (shoulder to hand): solid transparent milky precious opal, never hollow. Right arm (shoulder to hand): carved solid banded green malachite with concentric rings, completely opaque, completely opaque.

Torso, hips and both thigh-stubs (excluding arms): 9 equal horizontal bands, stacked top to bottom, each with a raised stepped edge and shadow at its border, no gaps, no skin. Band 1 (torso/hip band 1): carved solid vivid orange-red Osage orange wood, completely opaque. Band 2 (torso/hip band 2): carved solid dark chocolate-brown bocote wood with bold tiger-stripe patterns, completely opaque. Band 3 (torso/hip band 3): carved solid striking orange-red padauk wood, completely opaque. Band 4 (torso/hip band 4): carved solid richly streaked cream, rose-pink and violet Brazilian tulipwood, completely opaque. Band 5 (torso/hip band 5): carved solid deep black ebony with fine dense grain, completely opaque. Band 6 (torso/hip band 6): carved solid deep reddish-brown rosewood streaked with black, completely opaque. Band 7 (torso/hip band 7): clear turquoise water with drifting bubbles. Band 8 (torso/hip band 8): clear rose-pink water with drifting rose petals. Band 9 (both thigh-stubs, a little further below the middle of her thighs, just above where the knee would be): clear sapphire-blue water with drifting stars, sealing shut at both tips.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind her washed with two coloured lights from behind — a warm coral pink on one side and a deep teal on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath her.

Pose: standing tall, her left hand (crystal) resting on her flared hip, her right arm (stone) held clear of her body, the hand relaxed at hip height, both hands well away from her face, head tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: two large softboxes rake across her body from either side, so pink light glances off one side and teal light glances off the other, catching a crisp glint along every stepped seam. A soft frontal light falls on her face and ears only. shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
